text.tspan: ID
Requirement
Method
Criteria
REQ-DRIVING-001
reqPlanEachStep
test
Met when, in a run of SC-DRIVING-001, the
records hold at most one plan for each 100
ms step of simulation time and no two
consecutive steps without one, from the
end of priming to the end of the run or
the start of the stop response.
REQ-DRIVING-002
reqPlansByCheckpointInference
test
Met when every plan of a run of SC-
DRIVING-001 names the SHA-256 of the
checkpoint it was inferred with, and an
offline inference of that checkpoint on
the inputs recorded for a plan, on the
same host and software, gives every
acceleration and curvature of that plan
within 1 % of the largest magnitude of
that signal in the plan.
REQ-DRIVING-003
reqCameraImagesInCheckpointForm
test
Met when the inputs recorded for every
plan of a run of SC-DRIVING-001 hold six
current images of 512 by 512 pixels in
that order and a current front image of
1024 by 1024 pixels.
REQ-DRIVING-004
reqCameraHistory
test
Met when the inputs recorded for every
plan of a run of SC-DRIVING-001 hold, for
each camera, seven earlier images whose
capture times lie 0.5 s to 3.5 s before
the step at 0.5 s intervals.
REQ-DRIVING-005
reqProjectionOperators
test
Met when the inputs recorded for every
plan of a run of SC-DRIVING-001 hold one
projection operator for each image, and
the operator of each camera maps a
reference point at a known position in the
vehicle frame to within 2 pixels of where
that point appears in its image.
REQ-DRIVING-006
reqMapContextRaster
test
Met when the inputs recorded for every
plan of a run of SC-DRIVING-001 hold a
map_context of 14 channels and 450 by 300
pixels, tagged with the geometry
autoe2e-bev-450x300-0p4m-v1 and rendered
no more than 500 ms of simulation time
before the step.
REQ-DRIVING-007
reqRouteMaskRaster
test
Met when the inputs recorded for every
plan of a run of SC-DRIVING-001 hold a
route_mask of two channels and 450 by 300
pixels, tagged with the geometry
autoe2e-bev-450x300-0p4m-v1, whose route
corridor covers the route navigation gave
for the run.
REQ-DRIVING-008
reqEgoMotionHistory
test
Met when the inputs recorded for every
plan of a run of SC-DRIVING-001 hold 64
samples 100 ms apart by their sample
times, the newest at the step, each within
0.05 m/s and 0.1 m/s² of the speed and
acceleration that the simulator reports
for the commanded vehicle at that time,
and each with a yaw rate of 0 rad/s and a
curvature of 0 1/m.
REQ-DRIVING-009
reqHoldUntilHistoriesComplete
test
Met when, in a run of SC-DRIVING-001 that
starts with the vehicle at rest, the
commands hold it at standstill until the
run has recorded eight images of each
camera 0.5 s apart and 64 motion samples.
REQ-DRIVING-010
reqHistoriesFromCapturedInputs
test
Met when every image and sample given to
the checkpoint in a run of SC-DRIVING-001
has its own capture record of the run, and
no capture record appears twice in one
history.
REQ-DRIVING-011
reqCommandsFromNewestValidPlan
test
Met when, in a run of SC-DRIVING-001,
every command that reaches the actuation
of the vehicle names the plan it was
computed from and that plan names its
inference; when the autopilot and the
traffic manager of the simulator have no
control of the vehicle at any time of the
run and no recorded, replayed or scripted
control reaches its actuation; and when a
test plan of opposite curvature sign, put
in place of one checkpoint plan, reverses
the sign of the steering command within
100 ms of simulation time.
REQ-DRIVING-012
reqCommandsWithinActuationLimits
test
Met when, in a run of SC-DRIVING-001 in
which test plans that exceed the limits
named in the configuration are put in
place of checkpoint plans, every command
of the run stays within those limits.
REQ-DRIVING-013
reqPlanWithinPlanningPeriod
test
Met when, over a 60 s wall-clock window
that starts at the end of priming, in a
run of SC-DRIVING-001 with the simulation
at a real-time factor of at least 0.95, at
least 99 % of the plans are produced
within 100 ms of wall-clock time after
their newest camera image is available,
and no two consecutive plans miss it.
REQ-DRIVING-014
reqPlansAndCommandsOverSCORE
test
Met when, in a run of SC-DRIVING-001,
every command that reaches the actuation
of the vehicle is matched in the Eclipse
S-CORE communication records to the plan
it was computed from, and when, after the
Eclipse S-CORE communication of the
driving system is stopped in the run, no
further command computed from a plan
reaches the actuation.
REQ-DRIVING-015
reqPublishPlans
test
Met when, over a 60 s window of a run of
SC-DRIVING-001, every plan in the records
of the run is published once, equal to its
record, with its producer and its
production time, within 100 ms of wall-
clock time after that production time.
REQ-DRIVING-016
reqPublishVehicleState
test
Met when, over a 60 s window of a run of
SC-DRIVING-001, the motion sample of every
step in the records of the run is
published once, equal to its record, with
its producer and its sample time, within
100 ms of wall-clock time after the
driving system received it.
REQ-DRIVING-017
reqPublishHealthPeriodically
test
Met when, over a 60 s window of a run of
SC-DRIVING-001 that includes priming,
driving and a stop, no two consecutive
health publications are more than 200 ms
of wall-clock time apart, and each holds
the mode, the cause of the stop while
stopped, and the age of the newest valid
plan, with its producer and its production
time.
REQ-DRIVING-018
reqPlansIndependentOfObservation
test
Met when, with the same recorded camera
images, motion samples and route given to
the driving system, the plans and commands
of a run in which AAOS SDV receives
normally, of one in which it receives
every publication 1 s late, and of one in
which it is stopped each differ from those
of a reference run with AAOS SDV receiving
normally by no more than a second such
reference run differs from the first.
REQ-DRIVING-019
reqPlanningTimeIndependentOfObservation
test
Met when, in the three runs of the
criteria of REQ-DRIVING-018 and the
reference run, the 99th percentile of the
planning time of REQ-DRIVING-013 differs
by no more than 10 ms between any two of
them.
REQ-DRIVING-020
reqStopResponseDeceleration
test
Met when, in runs of SC-DRIVING-003
entered at 10 m/s and at 20 m/s, the
commanded deceleration from the start of
the stop response is 4 m/s² within 0.2
m/s² until standstill.
REQ-DRIVING-021
reqStopResponseSteeringHeld
test
Met when, in the runs of the criteria of
REQ-DRIVING-020, the steering command
stays at the last value computed from a
valid plan from the start of the stop
response until standstill.
REQ-DRIVING-022
reqStandstillAfterStop
test
Met when, in the runs of the criteria of
REQ-DRIVING-020, the vehicle stays at
standstill to the end of the run and no
command is computed from a plan made after
the stop response began.
REQ-DRIVING-023
reqStopOnDegradedCameraImages
test
Met when, in runs of SC-DRIVING-003 that
withhold the images of one camera and that
deliver a corrupt image, the stop response
begins within 100 ms of simulation time
after the limit is passed or the corrupt
image arrives, and when it does not begin
in a run of SC-DRIVING-001 without these
conditions.
REQ-DRIVING-024
reqStopOnDegradedMotion
test
Met when, in runs of SC-DRIVING-003 that
freeze the motion samples and that deliver
a sample with a value that is not finite,
the stop response begins within 100 ms of
simulation time after the limit is passed
or the invalid sample arrives.
REQ-DRIVING-025
reqStopOnDegradedRoute
test
Met when, in runs of SC-DRIVING-003 that
stop the route and that deliver a route
with an empty corridor, the stop response
begins within 100 ms of simulation time
after the limit is passed or the empty
route arrives.
REQ-DRIVING-026
reqStopOnStalePlan
test
Met when, in runs of SC-DRIVING-003 that
stall planning and that drop plans, the
stop response begins within 100 ms of
simulation time after the age of the
newest valid plan passes 300 ms.
REQ-DRIVING-027
reqStopOnInvalidPlan
test
Met when, in runs of SC-DRIVING-003 that
inject a plan with a value that is not
finite and a plan of 63 pairs, the stop
response begins within 100 ms of
simulation time after the invalid plan
arrives and no command is computed from
it.
REQ-DRIVING-028
reqStopOnLostCommands
test
Met when, in a run of SC-DRIVING-001 in
which the Eclipse S-CORE communication of
the driving system is stopped, the
commands at the actuation follow the stop
response from no later than 300 ms of
simulation time after the last command
arrived.
REQ-DRIVING-029
reqPublishStop
test
Met when, in each run of the criteria of
REQ-DRIVING-023 to REQ-DRIVING-028, a
publication that the driving system is
stopped, with the cause of that run,
follows within 100 ms of wall-clock time
after the stop response begins, and every
later health publication of the run shows
the mode stopped.
REQ-DRIVING-030
reqStampInputs
test
Met when every camera image and motion
sample in the records of a run of SC-
DRIVING-001 carries a capture time marked
as simulation time.
REQ-DRIVING-031
reqStampPlans
test
Met when every plan in the records of a
run of SC-DRIVING-001 carries the capture
time of its newest camera image marked as
simulation time and a production time
marked as the monotonic clock of the host.
REQ-DRIVING-032
reqStampCommands
test
Met when, from the records of a run of SC-
DRIVING-001 alone, for every command the
input age at actuation and the planning
interval are computed in simulation time
and the planning time and the Eclipse
S-CORE transport delay on the monotonic
clock of the host, and no computation
combines times of two domains.
REQ-DRIVING-033
reqRecordRunIdentity
test
Met when every run of SC-DRIVING-001 has
the record before its first plan, and
another engineer who hashes the named
checkpoint file and configuration and
checks out the named source revision
obtains the recorded values.
REQ-DRIVING-034
reqPlansNameRunRecord
test
Met when every plan in the records of a
run of SC-DRIVING-001 names the run record
of REQ-DRIVING-033.
REQ-DRIVING-035
reqRefuseUnpinnedCheckpoint
test
Met when, given a checkpoint file that
differs from the named one in a single
byte, and given a configuration that names
no checkpoint SHA-256, the driving system
produces no plan, the vehicle stays at
standstill, and the health names the
mismatch.
